svg.title: What each theorem actually uses
svg.desc: Choose a claim to expose its assumptions, supporting lemmas, checks and consequences. Assumption edges state retained scope; they do not assert that every condition is necessary.

g.title: Competitors have at most five states for the balanced-theta result.
q_ij>0 iff q_ji>0; paired zero rates are allowed.
Only x→y and y→x are individually observed, with known endpoints.
Every connected hidden realization satisfies a quadratic inequality whose discriminant supplies the exact quartic threshold.
Residue signs and reciprocal incidence eliminate every disconnected assignment except the source.
A separately derived cone generator matches the path witness exactly; certified entropy intervals are reproduced.
The balanced theta family has unbounded, two-point, then singleton entropy fibers across an exact quartic threshold.
Every four-state exact entropy fiber is singleton or unbounded; unknown support has only two unique incidence classes.

The candidate contribution now combines the support-exhaustive five-state fiber with an arbitrary-observation exact complete-source dichotomy, sharp local ceilings and finite-measurement/design consequences.

svg.text: Proof, numerical checks and novelty have separate statuses. Arrows use the relations in graph.json.
Interactive companion: select a node to read assumptions, typed relationships and exact provenance.
